integrity: The proof is analytic. Its new step is the arbitrary-rank holomorphic extension of an extremal dominated line via a projective graph transform; the Chern obstruction, scalar winding obstruction, and abstract existence theorem are used only in their arbitrary-rank forms stated in the cited source; the exact eigenvalue coset and carried simplicity are rederived directly from the scalar ratio of two sections on the same line. No numerical experiment is promoted to proof.
scientific_limitations: The result is line-resolved and assumes an extremal one-dimensional block of a uniform two-block dominated splitting, strip analyticity, invertibility, and a Diophantine two-torus translation. It does not classify spectrum carried by the complementary block or cover nonuniform, elliptic, noninvertible, or Liouville regimes.
title: Higher-rank dominated lines inherit the Chern–winding eigensection criterion
